description.en:
Lets husbandry mods be placed again after FS25 patch 1.25 changed the validation of the distance between fence posts.
Patch 1.25 added a minimum length for a fence segment. If one segment of a pasture's built-in fence is shorter, the pasture cannot be placed anywhere and the cursor shows "Distance too short". This mod lets those segments through again while you place a pasture.
This is a temporary fix that gives husbandry mod authors time to update their mods without hurry. It will be retired in a while, once authors have had time to update.
Features: - Pastures with a short built-in fence segment can be placed again - Should work for every pasture - A segment too short for one panel gets no panel, as before patch 1.25 - Fences you draw with the fence tool keep the 1.25 minimum length - Writes no savegame data; placed pastures still load after you remove the mod - Singleplayer only - this version does not support multiplayer.
Documentation: https://github.com/rittermod/FS25_FenceDistanceHotfix
Changelog: 0.0.1.0: - Added placement of husbandries the game refused with "Distance too short"; a built-in fence side too short for a panel is left without one
